Thirteen sectors share one method, and none accounts for more than 17% of the record.

HAYKALAH’s archive census counts 650+ engagements in 13 sectors, 2004–2026. The same deliverable chain, playbooks and screening run through all of them, and no sector is above 17% of the record. Each sector page shows what we do there, how we create value and the cases from the record.

Engagements by sector

650engagements across the 13 sectors, 2004–2026

  1. Ventures, technology apps & platforms HAYKALAH as institutional co-founder, from validation to capital readiness, with equity that vests at agreed gates. 108108 engagements
  2. Real estate & urban development Raw land to income-producing assets, from central Makkah and the Holy Sites to downtown Jeddah. 8686 engagements
  3. Hospitality, retail & lifestyle Market, feasibility, room-rate and debt-capacity studies for hotels in Makkah, Madinah and Jeddah. 8181 engagements
  4. Family offices & HNWI Ownership, governance, succession and waqf structures for families, with idle assets put to work. 5959 engagements
  5. Banking, capital markets & Sukuk Sukuk, funds, bank processes and tokenization readiness through FINA., with Shariah board approval and licensed partners. 5555 engagements
  6. Technology, digital & fintech Data rooms, AI reporting and investment-platform architecture, built in-house and with partners. 5555 engagements
  7. Industrial, manufacturing & energy Feasibility, project finance and PPP consortium structures for industrial and energy projects. 4848 engagements
  8. Healthcare & life sciences Bed-based economics, operator partnerships and capital readiness for hospitals and healthcare companies. 3434 engagements
  9. Government & sovereign Asset programs, PPP consortia, development companies and Sukuk frameworks for public entities. 3333 engagements
  10. Transport & logistics Demand studies and operating companies, including a parking venture taken from study to sale. 3232 engagements
  11. Hajj, Umrah & religious economy Land, pilgrim housing, hotels, waqfs and the Holy Sites in Makkah and Madinah. 2424 engagements
  12. Education & human capital Workforce and education ventures, including a flexible-work platform HAYKALAH built. 2222 engagements
  13. AgriTech & food (AGTI.) AI precision farming through AGTI., HAYKALAH’s agritech sub-brand. 1313 engagements

Engagement counts are indicative and total 650, from the archive census, 2004–2026. About 74 engagements were in the Two Holy Cities, across several of these sectors.
